about: Renew an Emirates ID card that has expired or is close to expiring.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels; the fields here were copied from the signed-in renewal form, where UAE PASS already fills most of them. Emirates ID renewal. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Residents can renew when the card has expired or has less than six months left
The passport must be valid for at least 3 months
A resident outside Dubai who renews together with a residence permit needs a medical exam result of fit
documents: A recent personal photo that is not the same as the photo on the current card
For residents, proof of the reason for residence such as a GCC ID, study, employment, investment or property papers, and attested family documents for relatives
fees: 100 AED per year of residence plus a 100 AED smart application fee
20 AED a day for renewing late, up to 1,000 AED
timing: Anyone aged 15 or over gives fingerprints and a signature at an ICP service centre
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
